dedupeText: retro romantic comedy soundtrack layout 1980s aesthetic serif typography ensemble cast high key lighting magenta accents white background central intimate couple flanked by two skeptical or observant individuals large scale magenta title text acting as a visual bridge between cast names and subjects horizontal band at the bottom providing a dark anchor for secondary metadata tight grouping of subjects creating a unified silhouette against the negative space combine high key ensemble photography with a white space heavy layout and high contrast serif typography in a single bold accent color

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast 1980s-style composition featuring a central group of four people against a stark white background, topped with layered serif typography in magenta and grey.
coreVisualRelationships: Central intimate couple flanked by two skeptical or observant individuals
Large-scale magenta title text acting as a visual bridge between cast names and subjects
Horizontal band at the bottom providing a dark anchor for secondary metadata
Tight grouping of subjects creating a unified silhouette against the negative space
coreInvariants: Pure white background for the upper two-thirds
Magenta as the primary accent color for text
High-key, soft-focus studio lighting on subjects
Heavy use of traditional serif typefaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are positioned in the lower half of the frame, cropped at the waist, occupying approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central smiling couple serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top metadata, drop to the large magenta title, and settle on the expressions of the four subjects below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space at the top allows for dense typographic layering without clutter.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black/Dark Navy (Bottom anchor and secondary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta (Primary title and lead cast names)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation magenta accents and naturalistic skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Large x-height for the main title
Significant stroke contrast between thicks and thins
characterSpecificRedesigns: Oversized curly quotation marks framing the title
Tight kerning in the main title to create a cohesive block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same serif family (Transitional/Modern).
graphicDevices: Horizontal dark bar at the bottom
Layered text blocks with varying opacity/color

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast transitional serif look of the 80s.
Captures the extreme contrast and ball terminals for the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of four young adults (two men, two women) in 1980s fashion. The central couple is embracing and smiling warmly. The two outer individuals look slightly skeptical or thoughtful. All subjects are against a seamless white background, cropped from the waist up. High-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large two-line title in magenta using a bold high-contrast serif font in the center. Above it, place four names in smaller magenta serif caps. At the very top, add three lines of smaller grey serif text. Add a dark navy horizontal bar at the bottom with small cyan serif text centered within it.

verificationChecks: Is the main title magenta and high-contrast serif?
Are the subjects grouped closely together?
Is there a dark anchor bar at the bottom?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (e.g., Cyan instead of Magenta)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subjects' faces.
Check that the magenta color is vibrant and not muted.
Verify the serif fonts have distinct thick/thin transitions.
Confirm the bottom bar is perfectly horizontal and centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-key ensemble photography with a white-space-heavy layout and high-contrast serif typography in a single bold accent color.
